description_en: Queries information about a node. A pipeline job contains a variety of nodes
description_zh: 工作流任务中包含多个节点，通过该接口获取节点的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow get-pipeline-run-node --pipeline-run-id flow-ebppc000000005lwea --node-id node-wcs9z0000000027ps3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPipelineRunNode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务的ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a node in the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务中一个节点的ID。如何查看节点ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The depth at which information about the node is queried. If you set Depth to 2, the information about the node and all its child nodes at the next layer is returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询节点详细信息的深度（层数），当Depth为2时，将会返回该节点及其下一层的所有子节点的详细信息
parameters.name: depth

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:

Logical (default): the logical node. The nodes submitted by users are logical nodes.
Physical: the physical node on which a container is deployed for executing specific logic. A logical node is converted to a physical node when the logical node runs in the background
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值如下：
Logical（默认值）：表示逻辑节点，用户提交节点的都是逻辑节点。
Physical：表示物理节点，对应一个执行特定逻辑的容器的运行，逻辑节点在后台运行时会转换为物理节点
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID
parameters.name: token_id

ApiVersion.description_en: The version defined in the pipeline

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the node, which can be modified
DisplayName.description_zh: 节点的展示名称（可能会被修改）

Identifier.description_en: The identifier of the pipeline for the node
Identifier.description_zh: 节点所对应的工作流的标识名

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

Pod: the specific node that runs.
Dag: the composite node, which is essentially a directed acyclic graph (DAG) consisting of child nodes
NodeType.description_zh:
节点的类型，可能值：

Pod：具体运行的一个节点。
Dag：复合类型节点，本质是一个由子节点组成的Dag图

Provider.description_en: The provider of the pipeline for the node. In most cases, this parameter indicates the uploader of the pipeline. If the pipeline is officially provided, the parameter value is PAI
Provider.description_zh: 节点所对应的工作流的提供方，通常情况下指代工作流的上传者（官方提供的工作流Provider为PAI）

RelatedNodeIds.description_en: The ID of the physical node corresponding to the Alink logical node or the ID of the logical node corresponding to the Alink physical node
RelatedNodeIds.description_zh: Alink逻辑节点所对应的物理节点ID或Alink物理节点所对应的逻辑节点ID
RelatedNodeIds.title_en: Alink逻辑节点所对应的物理节点ID / Alink物理节点所对应的逻辑节点ID
RelatedNodeIds.title_zh: Alink逻辑节点所对应的物理节点ID / Alink物理节点所对应的逻辑节点ID

Version.description_en: The version of the pipeline for the node
Version.description_zh: 节点所对应的工作流的版本

Dependencies.description_en: The dependencies between the node and other nodes
Dependencies.description_zh: 节点与其他节点的依赖关系

items.description_en: The name of the pipeline for other nodes that the node depends on
items.description_zh: 所依赖的其他节点对应工作流的名称

HasPipelines.description_en:
Indicates whether the node contains child nodes. Valid values:

true: The node is a composite node. To query information about its child nodes, you must specify the Depth parameter.
false: The node is the one that actually runs
HasPipelines.description_zh:
该节点是否含有子节点，可能值：
true：该节点为复合类型节点，如果需要进一步查询其子节点信息，需要传入更深的Depth参数。
false：该节点为实际运行的节点

Inputs.description_en: The input information about of the node

Parameters.description_en: The input parameters of the node

items.description_en: The input parameter of the node

Outputs.description_en: The output information about of the node

Parameters.description_en: The output parameters of the node

items.description_en: The output parameter of the node

Parallelism.description_en: The maximum parallelism of the nodes

Pipelines.example: For the detailed structure, see the description of Pipeline-related API operations.

items.example: 详细结构参见Pipeline相关接口描述。

When.description_en:
The condition on which the node runs.

If true is returned, the node is executed.
If false is returned, the node is skipped and the node status becomes Skipped
When.description_zh:
节点运行的判断条件。
如果运行条件返回为真，就执行该节点。
如果运行条件返回为假，该节点被跳过，状态为Skipped

WithItems.description_en: Expands one pipeline node into multiple pipeline nodes
WithItems.description_zh: 将工作流节点扩展为多个工作流节点

items.description_en: Expands an item in the dataset into a pipeline node
items.description_zh: 数据集中的一项，会扩展为一个工作流节点

WithParam.description_en: Expands each item in an array that is the value type of a parameter into a pipeline node
WithParam.description_zh: 指向一个参数，该参数的值是一个数组，数组的每一项会扩展为一个工作流节点

WithSequence.description_en: Expands each item of a numerical sequence into a pipeline node
WithSequence.description_zh: 指向一个数字序列，序列中的每一项会扩展为一个工作流节点

End.description_en: The end number of the numerical sequence

Format.description_en: Formats the value of the numerical sequence
Format.description_zh: 对数字序列的值进行格式化

Start.description_en: The start number of the numerical sequence

StatusInfo.description_en: The execution status of the node

Conditions.description_en: The running conditions of the node

items.description_en: The running condition of the node

FinishedAt.description_en: The time when the node finished execution

Progress.description_en: The running progress of the node

StartedAt.description_en: The time when the node started to execute

Status.description_en:
The running status of the node. Valid values:

Succeeded
Running
Failed
Skipped: The node status becomes Skipped when its upstream node fails to be executed.
ReadyToSchedule: The node status becomes ReadyToSchedule if its upstream node is being executed.
Unknown
Status.description_zh:
节点的运行状态，可能值：
Succeeded：运行成功。
Running：运行中。
Failed：运行失败。
Skipped：跳过（前序节点失败导致）。
ReadyToSchedule：准备运行（前序节点未完成导致）。
Unknown：未知
